introHtml: Sublimation printing allows you to apply vibrant, full-color designs directly onto the surface of no touch door opener tools. Unlike standard imprint methods, sublimation produces photographic-quality graphics that won’t peel or fade, making it ideal for detailed logos, safety instructions, or promotional messaging. For marketing directors and safety managers ordering bulk door openers, sublimation ensures your branding stands out while maintaining a professional, durable finish that holds up to daily use.
